_comment: Persona A cut sweep: 55% of training trials decided by the weights, 45% by the cut. Branches from A's run 20261106-152354 at decision step 1500.

Since 2026-11-24 asks the nine report questions every one-persona experiment asks: main, screen_index, screen_cut_units, main_report_units (shown a trial, 50 samples each) and main_threshold_met, main_threshold_not_met, screen_index_no_trial, screen_cut_units_no_trial, screen_cut_percent_no_trial (no trial, asked once each), every reply started with "{" (reply_prefix) and C shown in report trials (show_neither). Until then it asked the first 4 only, with no reply prefix and C not shown, and so was every run of it before that date. scripts/add_nine_questions.py.
Persona A (loose_leaf_tea): weights caffeine_content 0, leaf_size -83, oxidation_level -38, steeping_time -100, resteep_potential 31; screen: caffeine_content at 50% of its range.
Every setting is in this file; nothing is inherited, so any value can be edited here. README 'Settings' explains each field.

Sized for Qwen/Qwen3-8B on a 40 GB card (A100 40GB): micro_batch_size 5, gradient_checkpointing false, eval batches 96 (decision 96, introspection 8). Gradient checkpointing off: it recomputes every layer's activations in the backward pass, about 30% of training time, and only saves memory. The batch of 10 in two passes of 5, whose activations should fit without it (same effective batch, LoRA and 4-bit as the 16 and 24 GB files, so runs compare). Out of memory in training: gradient_checkpointing true (then micro_batch_size 10 fits in one pass). Out of memory in evaluation: eval batches 48, then 32.
Notes, written when this file listed only its changes over one_persona_minimum_threshold_a.json (those values are now written out here too):
Cut sweep: 55% of training trials decided by the weights, 45% by the cut (22.5% C, both options
below the cut; 22.5% one option below it, where the cut changes the answer from what the weights alone
would pick). Branches from 20261106-152354_paper_minimum_threshold_Qwen3-8B decision step 1500 (its adapter and AdamW
state) and trains steps 1501 to 3000, evaluated and saved every 100, over data/minimum_threshold_one_persona/cut_sweep/persona_a/w55_c45/.
Everything else is one_persona_minimum_threshold_a.json's. Written by scripts/make_cut_sweep.py.
save_optimizer last: each checkpoint keeps its adapter; AdamW's state only at the last.
